passed_checks.check_name: Ensure KMS key policy does not contain wildcard (*) principal
code_block:
BackupEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting database backups
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowBackupServiceAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - rds.amazonaws.com
                - s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
